normalized_failures.expected_meaning: Every declared dependency row must exist in the checkpoint commit with exact path, hash, bytes, regular-file kind, and no omitted or substituted rows.
normalized_failures.observed_meaning: A snapshot missing 63 of 64 declared dependency targets and snapshots with differing bytes for a declared frozen Plans row all passed under the same manifest.

normalized_failures.expected_meaning: Every executable validation or launch dependency must be included in the exact closure and reopened from the checkpoint commit.
normalized_failures.observed_meaning: v16 executes the v15 clean-room controller while that file is absent from the 64-row closure; the inherited verifier row is declared but not blob-checked, and inherited preflight validation is also outside the effective closure.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Candidate-v15 had no schema-valid post-audit freeze file set.
prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.remaining_gap: The validator proves only the closure-source summary, not the row targets or all executed inherited code.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Remove 63 dependency files or change a declared dependency blob while keeping summary/manifest bindings unchanged.

longest_valid_causal_prefix.basis: Candidate-v16 failed before freeze or subject launch.

decision_evidence.trigger: The authority facade fixed circularity but added an unbound inherited runtime boundary and failed to enforce the declared dependency tree before any empirical progress.

next_action.rule: Preserve v16. Create one standalone successor, not another facade. Copy only isolated passing semantic/controller components into candidate-local files, eliminate live v15/v16 controller imports or execution, and require the freeze validator to reopen every declared dependency blob from the exact checkpoint. Reproduce v16 acceptance, prove successor rejection, retain all prior cases, and require one independent PRESEAL_PASS before any canary.

nonclaims: This assessment is not a freeze, launch authorization, empirical result, clean matrix, qualification, or production-readiness claim.
